info.title: RemoteBuildTool
info.description: A content-hashed build cache for .NET repositories on CI. It fingerprints every project from its own inputs and its dependencies, restores unchanged projects and their test results from a shared cache, builds and tests only what changed, and gates coverage per project. An optional service fills the cache from merged pull requests and records build telemetry.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Restore hits from main, build misses, stage them in this run's store

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Print the project graph with each project's hashes

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Discover, verify, restore and hash every project; decide what main can serve

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Copy this run's entries into main

commands.name: release
commands.description: Build every project but the tests in Release under the next release

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run or reuse each test project; on Debug, gate coverage
